title: Prospectus enrollment: enrolled CLI and console logins, Account selection, fail-closed authorize, selling Papyrus newsrooms through Prospectus
description:
Planned 2026-10-31 from the Prospectus session's contracts (Prospectus main at ec6dbed; notes "Prospectus answers for Papyrus: login, CLI enrollment, selling"). Goal: every Papyrus login that touches an account is a Prospectus-enrolled login, every account-scoped operation is authorized by Prospectus and fails closed, and the CLI and console carry the selected Account ("Account", never "Organization"). This is what lets Papyrus newsrooms be sold through Prospectus. The Prospectus side is epic **kanbus-a93e35** "Sell Papyrus newsrooms through Prospectus" (board PR AnthusAI/Prospectus#95), owned by the Prospectus implementation session; this epic plans the Papyrus side in full and records the Prospectus work as dependencies.

## Decisions recorded 2026-10-31 (Ryan)
1. **APPROVED: the Papyrus CLI moves to each site's registered Prospectus federation client**, with the CLI callback URLs (a fixed-port loopback and `<origin>/cli/callback`) added to it, including the federation policy re-review (kanbus-b91466). Cognito and Prospectus registration changes are explicit, verifiable steps, each applied through the pipelines and approved by Ryan when synthesized. Verified fact: every `clientId` in Prospectus `accounts/papyrus-sites.json` is the `prospectus-google-only` client from `amplify/auth/prospectus-google-client.ts` (Google only, code flow, no secret, 60-minute tokens, callback `/api/auth/prospectus/callback`); the CLI today uses the MAIN web client in both modes (`lib/cli-login-discovery.ts` `client_id = outputs.auth.user_pool_client_id`, callback `http://localhost:3001/`; `site-backend.ts:180` gives the broker the same client). Only p.apyr.us, Pilobolus and Shipped are registered; Anth.us, Threat Intelligence, Distinctive Mark and Data Parade need entries first (kanbus-275596).
2. **APPROVED: the product setup in Prospectus**: per-site products `papyrus-<site>` and a sellable family `papyrus` (kanbus-db57cb, blocked by operator entitlement grants kanbus-592fbb), account creation from sites (kanbus-dbc30a), members:write and memberships with invites (kanbus-2823b5; invites depend on kanbus-59284c, kanbus-b2ddb4), lifecycle events `account.created` / `entitlement.changed` / `membership.changed` (kanbus-6efecd; Ryan still chooses the transport), the integration contract in `docs/accounts/PAPYRUS_SITES.md` (kanbus-634da2), billing as its own epic (kanbus-a78bcd, draft). Papyrus tasks that consume these are marked WAIT with the id.

3. **Data Parade is the pilot site** (Ryan 2026-10-31): a real client site, so it registers first (kanbus-275596), goes through the federation re-review first (kanbus-b91466), and is the first site for the enrollment route, account selection, fail-closed authorize and the CLI client move. Repo DataParade-newsroom, owned by the "DataParade.anth.us implementation" session; CMS host dataparade.anth.us, newsroom at `/newsroom`, Amplify app `d35q7zv4zad2we` (recorded here only; never in a repo file). The other six sites follow in a later wave.

## Open for Ryan
- Transport for lifecycle events (kanbus-6efecd): webhook to the site's content-actions URL, EventBridge bus, or SQS; recommended EventBridge (IAM, replay, no public endpoint).
- Which IAM principal is each site's registered `roleArn` (app-shell compute role or a dedicated role) and whether AppSync's own service role needs `executionDelegation`; the authorize task verifies read-only and reports.

## Contracts (from Prospectus; exact)
- `POST /v1/identities/google/challenge` body `{}` or `{"loginStateDigest": "<64 lowercase hex>"}` -> `{challengeId, nonce, issuedAt, expiresAt, challengeToken}` (`v1.<kid>.<payload>.<mac>`, 300 s). SigV4 as the site's `roleArn`.
- `POST /v1/identities/google/resolve` headers `X-Prospectus-Human-Token` (access token), `X-Prospectus-Identity-Token` (ID token); body `{"challengeToken", "loginState"}` (`loginState` `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$`, no dot). -> `{"person": {"id", "createdAt"}}`. Errors `401 challenge_invalid`, `401 login_state`, `409 challenge_replay`, `503` retry. ID-token nonce must equal the challenge nonce; `auth_time` within 300 s; ID `aud` = access `client_id` = the registered federation client.
- `GET /v1/identities/me` -> the Person for this exact enrolled login; `401/403 reenrollment_required` otherwise; `{"person": null}` when never enrolled.
- `POST /v1/accounts/{id}/authorize` header `X-Prospectus-Human-Token`; body `{"operation": "console:read" | "console:write" | "members:read"}` -> `{allowed, accountId, personId, product, role, operation, revision}` or `403`. Require returned `accountId` == requested; point-in-time, recheck before each effect. `GET /v1/accounts` lists the person's entitled accounts.
- cli-login 0.3.0 hooks: `prepare` on Approve calls challenge with `loginStateDigest = sha256hex(T)` (T = broker transaction id, never the full `T.N` state) and returns `(nonce, challengeToken)`; `enroll=` after the code exchange posts `{challengeToken, idToken, loginState: T}` with the access token to the site's enroll route; the CLI stores the session only on success.
- Copy, do not import: Prospectus `cli/src/prospectus_cli/pages.py` `LoginChallenges` (+ `pages_test.py`), `infra/lib/cli-sign-in.ts`, `infra/lib/cli-rewrite/`.

## What ships (Papyrus)
1. Federation review packet per site, Data Parade first (ready now); Data Parade pilot configuration (DataParade-newsroom).
2. CLI on the registered client behind a per-site flag; production flip after kanbus-b91466 approval.
3. Enrollment: `prepare` hook in the pages Lambda, `/cli/enroll` route, CLI `enroll=` hook, local login too (ready now).
4. Account selection: `papyrus accounts`, `papyrus login --account`, `X-Prospectus-Account` header; console chooser persisted and sent (ready now).
5. Authorize middleware, fail closed, `reenrollment_required` passed through (ready now).
6. `papyrus whoami` showing the person and account (ready now).
7. WAIT tasks: account creation from a site, membership and invite UI, provisioning on lifecycle events, selling/entitlement flow, billing.
8. p.apyr.us docs.

## Rules
Google sign-in only, never Cognito password users; "Account" never "Organization"; no emails, ids, ARNs or client ids in repos or fixtures (they live in Prospectus `accounts/papyrus-sites.json` and the sites' AWS config); Lucide icons; no borders; never colour alone; Gherkin for every behaviour change; PR -> CI -> merge; **no AWS writes and no Prospectus registration edits by implementers**: every Cognito, IAM, API-policy, grant or registration change is a synthesized diff Ryan approves and the pipelines apply.

## Related
PPY-58f107 (publication BFF with Prospectus accounts, in progress), PPY-3f14ad (membership index), PPY-1546fc / PPY-445274 (reader accounts), PPY-05cf41 (reader sign-in bug on Shipped), PPY-45efff (broker alarms), PPY-452419 (forum uses reader sign-in, not CLI enrollment).

## Acceptance for the epic
- `papyrus login` and `papyrus login --remote` on a registered site produce an enrolled login (`papyrus whoami` shows the Person and selected Account); an unenrolled or re-bound session is told to run `papyrus login` again.
- Every account-scoped CLI and console operation calls authorize and fails closed; a 403 or `reenrollment_required` is never swallowed.
- The CLI uses the registered federation client on every site with an approved review; the review packets are on the board.
- Gherkin for every behaviour; p.apyr.us documents sign-in, accounts and enrollment.

## Execution waves (2026-10-31, planning session). Data Parade goes first (Ryan); the other six sites follow.

### Wave 1 (start now, in parallel; shipped central routes; no shared files)
- PPY-fa41f4 federation packet script, Data Parade's packet first (Papyrus: scripts/prospectus-federation-packet.ts; read-only AWS).
- PPY-3c7557 CLI on the federation client, code only, flag default off (Papyrus: lib/cli-login-discovery.ts, amplify/auth/prospectus-google-client.ts, site-backend.ts ~173-187, infra/amplify-app-shell site-config.ts).
- PPY-098e22 enrollment (Papyrus: amplify/functions/cli-login-pages/, app/cli/enroll + challenge routes, lib/prospectus-enroll.ts, src/papyrus_content/cli_user_auth.py login paths).
- PPY-057e02 authorize helper and resolver pipeline function, flag default off (Papyrus: src/papyrus_content/prospectus_authorize.py, lib/prospectus-authorize.ts, amplify/data/resolvers/prospectus-authorize.js, message-actions.ts, profile-actions.ts, Lambda handlers). Header name fixed as X-Prospectus-Account / X-Prospectus-Human-Token.
- PPY-e64d38 Data Parade pilot, steps 1-2 (DataParade-newsroom infra/site.json; coordinate with the DataParade.anth.us implementation session) as soon as the packet exists.

### Wave 2
- PPY-2d3dd9 account selection (after PPY-098e22; shares cli_user_auth.py).
- PPY-ab3fce whoami (after PPY-2d3dd9).
- PPY-e64d38 steps 3-5: WAIT kanbus-275596 (Data Parade registered) and kanbus-b91466 (Data Parade's review approved by Ryan), then flip cliOnFederationClient, then prospectusAuthorize.

### Wave 3
- The other six sites: packets reviewed (kanbus-275596 for Anth.us, TI, Distinctive Mark; re-review for p.apyr.us, Pilobolus, Shipped), one site PR each flipping the flags in Data Parade's order. Shipped's happens after its console move (PPY-d8b616) so the callbacks are written once for newsroom.shipped.anth.us.
- PPY-06d692 docs.

### WAIT on Prospectus (kanbus-a93e35), each approved by Ryan when synthesized
- PPY-a1e75a: account creation (kanbus-dbc30a), members and invites (kanbus-2823b5, kanbus-59284c, kanbus-b2ddb4), provisioning on lifecycle events (kanbus-6efecd, transport still Ryan's choice), selling/entitlements (kanbus-592fbb, kanbus-db57cb), billing (kanbus-a78bcd). Split into tasks as each lands.

No AWS writes and no Prospectus registration edits by implementers; pipelines apply, Ryan approves.
